thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: release/2026-03-20-rc2 -> canary(us) -> eu -> apac. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Slices: us-canary 10% -> eu-slice 25% -> apac-slice 65%. Image: redwood/inference:2026-03-20-rc2. Rollback triggers: >5% 5xx over 5m, 99p token latency >1500ms, token cost anomaly >+20%. EU will be pinned to v2.3.1-quant for compliance check. Initiating preflight capacity checks now. :rocket:

alexis: Kicking off US canary smoke now. @maya can you run prompt-set smoke and look for regressions?

maya: Running smoke harness against us-canary. Command: ```/deploy start --slice us-canary --image redwood/inference:2026-03-20-rc2 --traffic 10%```
Results so far: QPS sim 120 req/s, avg latency 210ms, 95p 420ms, 99p 640ms. KV cache hit ~45%. No output drift on core prompt set. :white_check_mark:

tom: Checking infra: us-gpu-pool usage: 12/16 in use, 4 free. queued inference workers: 6 (expected). autoscaler headroom ok. No preemptions. Disk I/O nominal.

priya: Good. Hold EU ramp until eu capacity check completes. EU reserved capacity should keep >=20% free; if not, we hold and backfill from us. Also set rollout policy to pin EU to v2.3.1-quant (as noted). Rollback target is release/2026-03-15 if we see regression.

sam: FYI partner sync overlaps at 03:30 UTC — avoid >10% traffic shifts across APAC before 04:00 UTC.

release-manager: Plan: ramp US from 10% -> 15% now, run EU preflight in parallel, hold APAC at 0 until 04:00 UTC. If US stable for 10m, proceed to EU at 5% then 25% over 15m.

deploy-bot: US canary health checks: ✅ env probes ok, <0.5% 5xx, token cost within expected band. Requesting ramp permission.

alexis: :thumbsup: Ramp US to 15% now. Start EU capacity probes (light load).

maya: EU smoke results: QPS sim 95 req/s, avg latency 280ms, 99p 880ms. GPUs free in eu-gpu-pool: 4/12. KV cache hit 38%. Observed disk I/O spike on eu-storage-2: iops 18k (baseline 6k). Snippet: ```iostat -x 1 3
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  %util
eu-storage-2     120.3  330.8  20480  40960  62.1```

priya: Disk spike looks like backup overlap. Suggest disabling scheduled backup on eu-storage-2 for 10m and re-run. If 99p doesn't drop under 1200ms, hold and escalate.

tom: Disabled backup job eu-backup-03:20. Re-checking metrics. IOPS dropping: now 7.2k, %util 22.

maya: Re-run EU smoke: 99p dropped to 720ms, avg latency 260ms. No 5xx spikes. Good to proceed.

sam: APAC note: memory per-GPU in apac-cluster capped at 18GB for this window. APAC needs quantized variant to fit. Confirming model-tag v2.3.1-q4_0 is what we serve in apac-slice.

release-manager: Decision: EU will be pinned to v2.3.1-quant for the first 30m to run privacy/regression tests, then unpin if all good. APAC will get v2.3.1-q4_0 initially and ramp after 04:00 UTC. Rollback policy re-stated in slack: if >5% 5xx OR 99p token latency >1500ms for 5 continuous minutes, immediate partial rollback to release/2026-03-15 and alert SRE.

alexis: Noted. Executing ramp commands: ```/deploy scale --slice us-canary --to 15%``` ```/deploy start --slice eu-slice --image redwood/inference:2026-03-20-rc2 --pin v2.3.1-quant --traffic 5%```

deploy-bot: EU slice started at 03:12 UTC pinned to v2.3.1-quant. Healthchecks passing initial 3m: ok.

maya: Quick QA pass on EU: no obvious prompt regressions, hallucination smoke ok. Edge case test found tokenization diff in one prompt — filing quick ticket: INF-4321. Not blocking.

priya: Ops checklist: set rollback command ready in case: ```/deploy rollback --to release/2026-03-15 --slices eu-slice apac-slice``` I’ve also pushed an exception rule to Console that pins eu-slice to dedicated capacity routing for 30m.

tom: APAC preflight: apac-gpu-pool free GPUs 3/10 after other jobs. Memory fits with q4_0. Disk and network within thresholds. Recommend hold until 04:00 then ramp to 20% over 20m.

release-manager: Agreed. Runbook reminders: 1) If rollback, inform partners and disable canary route in gateway. 2) Notify legal if EU pin remains >2h. 3) Post-deploy validation: cost and 99p dashboards snapshot at +30m and +120m.

alexis: Thanks team. Will monitor for 30m, call rollback if any trigger breaches. :eyes:
